en.title: Nationwide Court Accessibility Service Desks Launch to Boost Disability Rights
en.summary: All district and high courts across the country have launched Accessible Service Desks, allowing disabled individuals to skip queue numbers and receive priority assistance. The initiative aims to improve judicial equality and access to justice for people with disabilities. Additional updates include new AI-powered alt-text generation tools and accessible golf car services at the World Cup.

zh-TW.title: 全國法院同步啟用無障礙服務台 提升司法平權
zh-TW.summary: 全國一、二審法院今日同步啟用無障礙服務台，讓身心障礙者可免抽號碼牌優先辦理。此舉旨在落實司法平權，改善殘障人士司法服務的可及性。同時，微軟Xbox無障礙團隊遭裁員衝擊，以及全州最多無障礙租賃住宅的榮譽亦成為今日焦點。
